family: R14-B breakthrough (dispatch 2): ETH cross-asset filter on frozen majority_1x (genuinely new data)
hypothesis: ETH trend/regime agreement as a veto/keep filter on frozen BTC majority_1x signals improves risk-adjusted return. Untried per ledger round14 B-eth.

eth_data.source: Binance public spot klines API (api.binance.com/api/v3/klines, NO key), symbol ETHUSDT, interval 6h
eth_data.clock: 6h bars opening 00/06/12/18 UTC (verified: open_time hour in {0,6,12,18})

features_exactly_3.eth_trend_rel: (eth_close - MA20(eth closes)) / MA20, MA20 = mean of 20 closes ending at reference bar inclusive
features_exactly_3.btc_ret30d: btc_now / btc_then - 1, btc_now = last BTC 5m candle close with close_time <= ref_close_time, btc_then = last BTC 5m candle close with close_time <= ref_close_time - 30d

derived_signs.eth_trend_sign: +1 if eth_trend_rel>0, -1 if <0, 0 on exact tie
derived_signs.btc_eth_agree: 1 iff sign(eth_ret30d)==sign(btc_ret30d) and both nonzero, else 0

causality: Per BTC signal_time S: reference ETH bar = last bar with close_time <= S (searchsorted right - 1). The still-forming 6h bar is ALWAYS excluded (live-faithful: at a 5m-close decision only closed bars exist). Require ref index >= 120 (full 30d lookback); assert all ref close_times <= signal_times.

filters.control: keep all 94 majority signals (no ETH condition)
filters.eth_trend_agree: keep iff eth_trend_sign == signal direction (+1/-1). Exact tie (sign 0) DROPS.
filters.eth_up_only: keep iff eth_trend_sign > 0 (both LONG and SHORT kept only in ETH uptrend)

dd_guard.reference: OWN control_1x equity from THIS run (majority rerun normal-cost trades)
dd_guard.formula: lev 0.5 while control equity >10% under its trailing peak at signal time (past-only, strictly-before 1-microsecond cutoff, 100.0 seed level), else 1.0; applied at each branch's own filtered signal times; ExecutionConfig leverage=0.25 max_leverage=1.0; 1x branches drop leverage column with ExecutionConfig 1.0/1.0 (v15 convention; engine clips signal leverage into [execution.leverage, max_leverage])

costs: dataset config costs (fee 0.0002/fill normal); fee_stress fee_rate_per_fill=0.00055; execution_stress FillStress(entry_penetration_bps=5, target_penetration_bps=5, market_exit_slippage_bps=5, market_exit_fee_rate=0.00055, allow_limit_price_improvement=False), exposure<=1x
monthly_formula: ratio^(1/(12*duration_years))-1, duration from parent_plan folds[0][0] to complete_evaluation_until

control_reference.note: majority_1x published (v15/B4, v23 XUAT_BAN). Mismatch -> STOP.
